name: Green-Flame Blade
materials: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp
description_json: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The second creature takes fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

description_html: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and you can cause green fire to leap from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. at_higher_levels: At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 fire damage to the target on a hit, and the fire damage to the second creature increases to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 2d8) and 17th level (3d8 and 3d8).

damage_at_slot_level.0: (target creature): weapon damage, (other creature): spellcasting ability modifier
damage_at_slot_level.5: (target creature): weapon damage + 1d8 fire damage, (other creature): 1d8 + spellcasting ability modifier
damage_at_slot_level.11: (target creature): weapon damage + 2d8 fire damage, (other creature): 2d8 + spellcasting ability modifier
damage_at_slot_level.17: (target creature): weapon damage + 3d8 fire damage, (other creature): 3d8 + spellcasting ability modifier
